retrievalProfile.description: Use this skill for 1980s-inspired media covers featuring high-contrast lighting, luxury vehicles, and bold geometric typography in neon palettes.
excludeWhen: requesting monochromatic black and white photography

recipe.visualDefinition: A cinematic composition featuring two men in 80s fashion flanking a white luxury sports car against a vibrant green-to-black gradient background, topped with layered, stylized geometric typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Symmetrical placement of figures around a central vehicle
Typography layered over a solid rectangular block
Gradient background transitioning from vibrant green to deep black
coreInvariants: Cyan and magenta color pairing in the primary logo
White luxury sports car as the central horizontal anchor

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central horizontal car occupying the lower two-thirds; two human figures at medium-full scale on either side.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The white sports car serves as the primary horizontal anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the bold top-center typography, move down to the car, and then outward to the two figures.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant open space in the upper half occupied by the gradient and title.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Vibrant emerald green gradient to black
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Electric cyan for primary text and ground lighting
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Neon magenta for secondary text elements
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the background and text contrasting with the neutral white of the car.

characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'V' and 'I' in the secondary line are slanted and overlap the background block
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Bold geometric display type paired with a clean, small-scale sans-serif for metadata.
graphicDevices: Solid cyan rectangular bar behind text
Blue neon under-glow effect beneath the car

avoid: Serif fonts for the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the 80s art deco revival feel
Provides the necessary geometric skeleton for the 'M' and 'A'

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photo of two men in 1980s linen suits standing next to a white 1980s Italian sports car. The background is a vertical gradient from emerald green at the top to black at the bottom. Add a blue neon glow on the ground under the car.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the title in large, wide geometric sans-serif. The first word is cyan. The second word is magenta and overlaps a cyan horizontal bar. Add Roman numerals below in cyan.

verificationChecks: Is the car white and centrally located?
Does the background feature a green-to-black gradient?
Is the typography layered with cyan and magenta colors?

postGenerationChecks: Verify the presence of the horizontal bar behind the text
Ensure the car has a blue ground-glow
Confirm the green gradient is vibrant and saturated
